# 00000008085

**FUS-05 ★** — source: 255_有限群与融合系统.md

**English.** Definition: The fusion-transitivity of the J-functor of Thompson subgroups of Sylow p-subgroups: the F-invariance index J_F of J(S) (the subgroup generated by elementary abelian subgroups of maximal rank). Conjecture: The J-functor is weakly F-invariant in every saturated fusion system (the fusion version of Thompson transitivity); the failure of strong F-invariance is equivalent to the existence of exotic local subgroups (a strong-invariance singularity duality); and the lower bound on |S| of the minimal failing system is p^{11} (a fusion size threshold), the threshold being given by the exceptional isomorphism of the spinor center of the 12-dimensional orthogonal group over GF(2). (Thompson J-functor weak invariance threshold)

**中文。** 定义：Sylow p-子群的 Thompson 子群的 J-函子的融合传递性：J(S)（含最大秩初等交换子群生成的子群）的 F-不变性指标 J_F。猜想：J-函子在一切饱和融合系统中弱 F-不变（Thompson 传递的融合版）；且强 F-不变性的失效等价于存在 exotic 局部子群（强不变-奇异对偶）；失效的最小系统的 |S| 的下界为 p^{11}（融合尺寸阈值），阈值由 GF(2) 上的 12 维正交群的 spinor 中心的例外同构给出。
